## Text
A person cannot by reference to any contract term exclude or restrict liability for negligence except
in so far as the term satisfies the requirement of reasonableness.

## In plain words
In Singapore, a term that limits liability for negligence only works if a court finds it reasonable.

## When it matters in an NDA or service agreement
Liability caps and exclusions in service agreements.
